package: @astryxdesign/core

# FieldLabel

Standalone label group for one control or a caller-labelled group, with optional supporting text, optionality indicators, icon, and tooltip.

**Import:** `import {FieldLabel} from '@astryxdesign/core/Field';`

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `label` | `string` | - | Label text, always rendered for accessibility. **(required)** |
| `inputID` | `string` | - | ID of the input this label is for. **(required)** |
| `labelID` | `string` | - | ID applied to the label element itself. Use it with `aria-labelledby` when `isGroupLabel` is true. |
| `isGroupLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | Render a span that can name a group instead of a native label for one control. |
| `isLabelHidden` | `boolean` | `false` | Visually hide the label and description while keeping both available to assistive technology. |
| `isDisabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Use disabled label presentation for the associated control. |
| `isOptional` | `boolean` | `false` | Show the localized optional indicator unless it matches FormLayout's default optionality. |
| `isRequired` | `boolean` | `false` | Show the localized required indicator unless it matches FormLayout's default optionality. |
| `labelIcon` | `ReactNode \| IconType` | - | Icon or rendered icon content before the label text. See `astryx docs icons` for semantic names. |
| `labelTooltip` | `string` | - | Help text for an info button after the label, named "About {label}". Hover and keyboard focus preview it; a tap, click, Enter, or Space opens it and never focuses or toggles the control. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | - | Supporting content displayed below the label and kept separate from the control's accessible name. |
| `descriptionID` | `string` | - | ID applied to the supporting description for caller-owned `aria-describedby` wiring. |
| `ref` | `React.Ref<HTMLLabelElement>` | - | Ref forwarded to the label element. Group mode currently renders a span. |
| `xstyle` | `StyleXStyles` | - | StyleX styles applied to the label element after its base and state styles. |
| `className` | `string` | - | CSS class name appended to the label element. |
| `style` | `React.CSSProperties` | - | Inline styles applied to the label element after StyleX inline styles. |
